chapter_seo_title: Dao Twisted World Chapter 266: Li Huowang's Search for the Jian Tian Si
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang scours a county town for the elusive Jian Tian Si. When direct investigation fails, he pivots to a smarter strategy: find the disaster, and they will come.
og_title: The Hunt for the Heavenly Office
og_description: Li Huowang can’t find the Jian Tian Si by asking around—so he decides to look for the kind of catastrophe that will force them to show up.
twitter_title: When you can't find the monster hunters, become the disaster they're looking for.
twitter_description: Li Huowang hits a wall in his search for the Jian Tian Si and pivots to a terrifyingly clever new strategy in this quiet but tense chapter.

lore_anchors.definition: A government-sponsored supernatural law enforcement body in the Dao-Twisted World, believed to be under the imperial board of war; they hunt rogue cultivators and manage large-scale ontological disasters called Heavenly Calamities.
A general xianxia term for a cultivator's supernatural power or magical ability; can range from enhanced senses to reality-warping feats.
The destination marked on Bai Lingmiao's map; the ancestral home of the Bai family that she has been searching for.
A face-covering woven from threaded old Chinese coins; in the Dao-Twisted World, it provides concealment from supernatural perception, making it a high-value artifact Li Huowang refuses to remove.
